title: Till The Light
description:
Welcome to Till The Light!

A psychological horror about a convenience store, a mysterious entity, and the truth of your own existence..._                                                                            _

_                                                                             _

Description:You work the night shift at a mysterious convenience store that's anything, but normal, however others say otherwise making you question whether or not you're really the sane one here. Each night after your shift you meet with a guide-like entity in your dreams, helping you slowly uncover the truth surrounding the store, the world you live in, and most importantly who you really are...

Gameplay:This game is a first-person horror in which the player will work night shifts at a convenience store, serving customers around the store, and experience bizarre dreams per night after work.

_                                                                            _
